title: Q-BENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR GENERAL-PURPOSE FOUNDATION MODELS ON LOW-LEVEL VISION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on 'Yes-or-No' visual question answering tasks and comparing the prediction accuracy on ground-truth 'Yes' questions versus ground-truth 'No' questions to quantify the models' inherent preference for answering 'Yes', along with calculating a de-biased accuracy.

Analyzing the distribution of zero-shot model responses (e.g., numerical scores or qualitative tokens like 'good' vs 'poor') in Image Quality Assessment (IQA) tasks to identify statistical tendencies to output extremely positive ratings rather than a balanced distribution.
